ideas.pitch: A real-time voice assistant built on Agora SDK that helps Bengaluru commuters navigate complex traffic, metro delays, and flooded underpasses using live voice conversational loops.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for Bengaluru: Develop AI-powered solutions addressing everyday urban challenges.
ideas.title: NammaRoute Voice: Bengaluru Commute & Traffic AI Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets local judges' daily pain points in Bengaluru traffic, making the demo instantly relatable and memorable.

ideas.pitch: An agentic voice shopping assistant that communicates over live Agora audio streams to negotiate prices and check local inventory from street vendors in real-time.
ideas.problem_statement: Voice-First Commerce: Reimagine shopping and customer experiences through natural voice interactions.
ideas.title: AuraShop: Voice-First E-Commerce Negotiator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep integration of Agora's real-time streaming alongside low-latency tool-use execution, fulfilling the voice-first commerce track perfectly.

ideas.pitch: A browser-based multiplayer mini-game where players command units and coordinate actions using natural speech streamed directly through Agora RTC channels.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-Time Multiplayer & Gaming: Create interactive gaming experiences powered by real-time voice and communication technologies.
ideas.title: SquadCall: Real-Time Voice-Controlled Multiplayer Strategy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in the gaming track love low-latency interactive demos that show off Agora's core audio routing capabilities combined with live game states.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that answers emergency support calls over Agora audio, diagnoses software or hardware failures, and triggers automated remediation workflows via APIs.
ideas.problem_statement: Agentic AI: Develop AI agents that use tools, APIs, and automated workflows to solve real-world problems.
ideas.title: AutoFix Agent: Autonomous Customer Support Voice Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust agentic tool-use with live telephony/WebRTC audio, matching the enterprise automation trends seen in winning hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent conversational voice partner built on Agora that helps newcomers practice conversational Kannada in real-time with instant pronunciation corrections.
ideas.problem_statement: Voice AI & Conversational AI: Build intelligent voice assistants and conversational agents that understand and respond naturally.
ideas.title: BalaBhasha: Vernacular Voice Tutor for Kannada Dialects
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on regional localization which deeply connects with a Bengaluru-based developer and judge audience.
